propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD via git merge, making the result depend on the tracker's checked-out branch, and _require_tracker_on_ref refuses heals when current_branch != ref
The heal must fold bundle heads into the published ref's tip (refs/heads/<ref>) independent of which branch is checked out, using git merge-tree --write-tree and git commit-tree instead of git merge

The fold must preserve merge policy: the configured ours driver and .gitattributes .bridge_state/* merge=ours directive must be honoured so that tracker-side .bridge_state conflicts are kept rather than failing
Off-branch and detached-HEAD trackers must heal successfully without moving the checked-out branch; on-branch heals must update HEAD/index/worktree to match the merged tip
A dirty tracked worktree on the checked-out ref must be refused before download; a real content conflict must raise S3DoctorConflict and delete no bundle
All existing s3_doctor tests must remain green and new tests must verify off-branch healing, detached HEAD healing, merge policy preservation, and worktree state consistency
